description: Use this when you need the readable text of a public web page as clean Markdown. Self-hosted on BitTuitive hardware (no upstream). Pass url (a public http(s) page). Optional links=true includes in-page links. JavaScript rendering is not available. If the URL is a PDF, use convert_pdf instead. Priced at $0.001 plus the BitTuitive fee max(20%, 3 sats), typically about 5 sats. Unpaid calls return an L402 invoice and an x402 quote. robots.txt is respected. Pay by calling without a credential, paying the Lightning invoice or the USDC amount, then retrying with l402_credential='<macaroon>:<preimage>' or x402_payment. One payment buys one response. Or prepay at /api/v1/credits (Bearer btf_ token) or add ?bt_pass=1 for a 5-minute pass. Details: https://api.bittuitive.ai/pay. Example: fetch_page(url="https://example.com/article") Informational only; not financial, investment, legal or tax advice; provided as-is, with no warranty; verify before acting. https://api.bittuitive.ai/disclaimer.

credit.description: 24h credit token from an earlier failed fetch_page call.

credit_token.description: Prepaid btf_ token (or pass Authorization elsewhere).

l402_credential.description: L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' from a paid invoice (or an active subscription). Omit it on the first call to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

links.description: Include a list of in-page links (default true).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a web page (max 2 MB).

x402_payment.description: x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload signed for accepts[0] of the payment_required result. Alternative to l402_credential; also accepted in params._meta['x402/payment'].
